Letter dated 11 August 2026
GUARANTEE AND INDEMNITY — FOOD INGREDIENTS

To: Medosweet Farms, Inc., 1150 Central Ave N, Kent, WA 98032.

The supplier named in the closing block below guarantees that no article of food delivered under any purchase order placed by the addressee is adulterated or misbranded within the meaning of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, and undertakes to indemnify the addressee against loss arising from any breach of that guarantee.

This is a continuing guarantee. It attaches to every shipment made after the letter date shown above and remains effective until it is withdrawn by written notice; no fixed term applies and no renewal date is set. It supersedes the guarantee dated 04 January 2024 and the interim addendum of 17 June 2025. Our facility registration under the Bioterrorism Act was last renewed on 30 September 2025 and our most recent unannounced GFSI audit was completed on 22 May 2026.
